column1: # config/full_suite_manifest.tsv -- declared set of test entry points for scripts/run_full_suite.sh
# reviewed; regeneration keeps existing rows as they are. Every census file must have exactly one row;
# a census file without a row, or a row without a file, makes the runner refuse (exit 3).
# Columns (TAB): path kind class tier runner covered_by note
#   kind    sh | py | go (path = Go module dir) | runall | js | bats
#   class   entry (run as a unit) | member (run only through covered_by, which must invoke it)
#           | fixture (under a fixtures/ dir, never run) | excluded (not a test; see note)
#   tier    default | heavy (run only with --include-heavy) | - (fixture, excluded)
#   runner  bash | sh | python3 | go-test | node | bats | runall-whole | runall-quick | runall-members | -
#   note    free text; `override:` documents a curated deviation; excluded rows need
#           `reason: helper: sourced by <path>` is checked against the shell model of <path>; a
#           test-named file is excluded only with `override: reason: <category>: <why>`. The excluded
